prompt:

- name: Eve, Carol, Bob, Frank, Alice, David

14. The person whose pet is rabbit lives in house 5.
15. The person whose hobby is gardening lives in house 1.
16. Alice and the person whose favorite drink is tea are the same person.
17. The person whose favorite drink is milk does not live in house 2.

19. The person whose favorite color is white and the person whose favorite drink is coffee are not the same person.

24. The person whose favorite drink is soda and the person whose hobby is chess are not the same person.
25. The person whose favorite drink is coffee and the person whose pet is fish live next to each other.

Determine which values belong to each house. Submit your answer as JSON with exactly these keys: {"name": [...], "color": [...], "pet": [...], "drink": [...], "hobby": [...]}. Each list has 6 entries, the value in house 1 first and the value in house 6 last.
